name: bu_Sr4Ti4O12
title: SrTiO3 (Sr4Ti4O12) crystal
description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of the perovskite SrTiO3 with four formula units (20 atoms) per cell, enough for octahedral tilt systems (a0a0c-, I4/mcm: the experimental low-temperature phase; cubic Pm-3m above 105 K; a-b+a- Pnma as in CaTiO3); ilmenite and hexagonal-perovskite arrangements compete. In NEP89 tilts gain < 1 meV/atom, so cubic and tilted perovskites are nearly degenerate. guard_factor 0.80: NEP89 has a short-range Sr-O hole (with the default 0.75 an unphysical Sr2Ti2O6 structure with Sr-O = 1.93 A was 0.046 eV below the perovskite).
